def f(xs):
    ordered = sorted(xs)
    side = len(ordered) % 2
    return ordered[side::2][::-1] + ordered[1-side::2]
note: Sort with duplicates and alternate sides around the minimum, keeping the largest at the right. Odd-length tests imply starting on the left despite the wording; empty input gives [].

def f(xs):
    out = []
    for x in xs:
        sign = -1 if x < 0 else 1
        n = abs(x)
        out.append(sign * (n // 100 * 100 + n % 10 * 10 + n // 10 % 10))
    return out
note: Swap tens and ones, padding one-digit numbers with leading zero; preserve higher digits and sign.
